acceptance.newLand: verify exact fen archetype from metadata; do not infer from folder label
require: same verifiedSource hashes and probe version
completedTarget true; targetYear1450; stoppedFor target_year; no unsupported control drift
periodYear1300..1449 once each, sample year=periodYear+1 and tick=4000*(year-1300)
controls match at start, command before/after and all annual boundaries
partialYearCounters disclosed separately; never add an extra full year

alignment.difference: fen - open at same periodYear for flows and same boundary tick for stocks
alignment.relativeDifference: (fen-open)/abs(open) only when open != 0; otherwise null with zero-baseline label
alignment.earlyStop: publish overlapping completed years and explicit censored remainder; no zero filling

metrics.formula: plot each annual boundary; report first/end/min/max/arithmetic mean of boundaries; 25-year block terminal snapshot
metrics.limits: stock changes are not gross revenue, spending, production, trade volume, welfare or resource conservation; timber is lord reserve separate from building inventory logs/timber; foodReserveTicks is an engine estimate at a boundary, not days or duration of hunger

metrics.formula: sum per period; per-year mean=sum/completedYears; no-change=attempted-changed; asked+own=changed; command rows bucket by floor(tick/4000)+1300
metrics.limits: changed means reducer object reference changed, not effect success; decisionsByKind counts only changed commands; asked/own are bot classification, not human questions or spontaneous strategy

metrics.formula: separate counts of attempted==0, changed==0, asked==0; maximum and median; descriptive busy proxy changed>=5/year with sensitivity thresholds3,5,10 fixed before fen inspection; also attempted>=5 to expose retries
metrics.limits: 5 is analysis convention, not engine overload or human burden; zero commands does not mean zero events; pauseTicks counts ticks with a reason, not elapsed real pause time; sum pauseReasons can exceed pauseTicks

metrics.formula: snapshot by cause, net difference from prior snapshot; first difference from verified start persons.past; report negative differences without clamping; validate against final unique person IDs/deathYear only if separately supplied
metrics.limits: persons.past dead records only, not all factions/estates worldwide; counter difference is not automatically newly dead cohort; death causes age/famine/famine_year/plague/fire kept distinct; no death rate without person-time/at-risk denominator; history person.died and retained count need not match

metrics.formula: align stable IDs; boundary title/possession/fragment state sets and adjacent changes; separate parent estate title vs piece rights; value is annualValue field not actual cash collected
metrics.limits: annual samples miss within-year changes; absent ID is missing until schema/state proves absence; no acquisition cause from relation or closed suit alone; statuses are snapshots not yearly flows

metrics.formula: per faction observed boundary count, first/final/min/max relation, distinct leader IDs, adjacent observed leader changes; report null/absence separately
metrics.limits: not full succession count; changes within year may be invisible; relation differences do not prove command or terrain causation

metrics.formula: tradeId household counts; first observed positive boundary, min/max/final, sum trade households; absent key=0 only under the same complete counts serializer
metrics.limits: not persons occupation census, workforce, skill, output or full-city employment rate; tradeStock separate from building inventory

metrics.formula: report as retained snapshot; use selections/waits/outcomes logs for their expressly logged subsets
metrics.limits: retained occurrences/records cannot be summed as total lifetime arrivals; decisions and registrations are not all offered choices or fun

notCaptured: actual time spent thinking or UI idle time
gross annual ledger inflows/outflows by category
causalBoundary: A single same-seed pair is a descriptive trajectory comparison. Different land can alter available actions, event timing and random draw paths. Do not label observed differences a direct terrain effect, a general land ranking, or a policy effect. No engine simulation, SSH, code installation or new probe implementation in this design.
